fields.name: Chhaava
fields.description: Chhaava is a historical drama based on the life of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj. The movie follows his courage, leadership and struggle to protect the Maratha Empire.

fields.name: Doreamon
fields.description: Doraemon is a Japanese animated movie featuring Doraemon and Nobita on a fun and exciting adventure. They face new challenges and help each other throughout the journey.

fields.name: 3 Idiots
fields.description: 3 Idiots is a comedy-drama about three college friends who discover the true meaning of friendship, education, and following their dreams.

fields.name: Alpha
fields.description: Alpha is an action thriller about a fearless young woman who faces dangerous enemies and uncovers hidden truths from her past.

fields.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
fields.description: Peter Parker continues to protect New York as Spider-Man in a world where no one remembers him. He faces new challenges, mysterious changes, and a dangerous new threat.

fields.name: Avtar Fire and Ash
fields.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash continues the journey on Pandora as Jake Sully and his family face new challenges, powerful enemies, and unexplored regions.

fields.name: Toy Story
fields.description: Toy Story is an animated adventure about Woody and Buzz Lightyear, two toys who go on an exciting journey and discover the true meaning of friendship.

fields.name: Laalo – Krishna Sada Sahaayate
fields.description: Laalo is a Gujarati devotional drama about a struggling rickshaw driver who becomes trapped in a mysterious farmhouse. Guided by visions of Lord Krishna.

fields.review_text: Amazing movie! Story and action were really good.
